_README: CleanYourTV Android TV Fleet Configuration Template. Copy to 'config.json' and customize for your home network.

_GUIDE.subnet_prefix: First 3 octets of your local LAN (e.g. '192.168.1' or '10.0.0'). Used by the ARP/ADB dynamic IP resolver.
_GUIDE.dhcp_scan_range: [start_host, end_host] range to sweep when a TV's IP changes under DHCP lease renewals.
_GUIDE.how_to_find_model: Run 'adb -s <TV_IP>:5555 shell getprop ro.product.model' or 'getprop ro.product.device' to find your TV identifier.
_GUIDE.how_to_enable_adb: On your Android TV, go to Settings -> Device Preferences -> About -> Click 'Build' 7 times. Then go to Developer Options -> Enable 'USB / Network Debugging'.
